slides.title: Plumbers: 5 dates that sneak up on you in December
Your plumbing license
slides.body: Plenty of them renew at year-end. Some want CE hours first.

slides.title: Your liability certificate
slides.body: The GC wants this year's COI, not last year's.

slides.title: Backflow cert, workers' comp, truck registrations
slides.body: Three more dates, three different months, zero reminders unless you set them.

slides.title: Save this before December
slides.body: Then write all five dates down somewhere that reminds you before they expire.
